what_it_does: Creates/updates company admin from Send2: stores plain username, admins.id from request id, hashed + vault password, auto-creates unique short tenant_id (or reuses existing for same admins.id; optional tenant_id links second admin to same company). Returns session_id. Public endpoint — no auth headers.
optional_body_fields: tenant_id (string) — pass existing tenant_id to attach second admin to same company; omit to auto-create new tenant_id
request_field_details: username (string, plain, required) | id (string/number, required) = chatbot admins.id PK e.g. 12234 | password (string, required) | tenant_id (string, optional)
error_codes: 400 invalid input / duplicate username | 502 signup failed
frontend_bind_notes: Not called from admin panel UI normally. After signup store returned id + session_id + tenant_id. Admin later authenticates with username + session_id headers. onboarding_approved stays false until first-login/complete publishes profile v1.

what_it_does: Lists all admin + sub_admin accounts for the privileges dropdown (id + username + role + tenant_id). Superadmin only.
request_field_details: No body fields required. Auth only via headers username + session_id.
frontend_bind_notes: Bind dropdown options to users[]. Display label: username (id). On select, store selected id and call menu-privileges/get. Helper: menuPrivilegesApi.users()

ui_screen: Privileges panel — load checkboxes after dropdown select
what_it_does: Returns selected user's menu privileges as active/inactive map + items[] for checkbox UI. Superadmin target is read-only (all active, editable=false).
request_field_details: id (int, required) = admins.id of selected dropdown user | user_id (int, optional alias)
frontend_bind_notes: Privilege keys: graphic, chats, profile, customer, website_crawler, setup_chatbot, menu. Prefer privileges{} or items[].active for checkboxes. If editable===false do not allow Save. Nav mapping: graphic→overview, chats→inbox, profile→profile, customer→customers, website_crawler→website-crawler/uploads, setup_chatbot→profile-menu/settings, menu→menu. Helper: menuPrivilegesApi.get({id})

what_it_does: Saves active/inactive menu grants for selected admin/sub_admin. Cannot save for superadmin (always full menus).
optional_body_fields: user_id (alias of id) | menu_ids (string[]) alternative to privileges map | privileges_ids (int[]) catalog ids
request_field_details: id (int, required) | privileges (object, preferred): keys graphic|chats|profile|customer|website_crawler|setup_chatbot|menu with boolean true=active
error_codes: 400 cannot save for superadmin / invalid target | 401 | 403 | 404
frontend_bind_notes: Send checkbox state as privileges{}. true keys become grants. After save refresh get or use response.privileges. Helper: menuPrivilegesApi.save({id, privileges})

what_it_does: Lists all company admin + sub_admin users for customer_care onboarded-users view (tenant_id + onboarding_approved). Used for login-as / support access list.
request_field_details: Empty JSON body. Auth via headers only.
frontend_bind_notes: Table columns: username, role, tenant_id, onboarding_approved (Approved/Pending), created_at. onboarding_approved=true only after Set up chatbot published profile v1 (not merely having tenant_id). Helper: adminsApi.onboardingUsers()

ui_screen: Company admin — Set up chatbot wizard (Finish)
what_it_does: Finishes onboarding for logged-in company admin. tenant_id is taken from authenticated admin (username+session_id) — do NOT send tenant_id in body. Sets WhatsApp phone, company/brand snapshot, publishes profile v1, unlocks console (onboarding_approved=true).
auth_headers: username: japan | session_id: <that admin live session from signup/login>
who_can_call: role=admin with signup tenant_id and unpublished profile (version 0)
optional_body_fields: files ([{filename, content base64}]) | lane (kit|any) | upload_draft (staged bifurcation object)
request_field_details: waba_phone_id (string) | mobile_number (string, country code + digits) | snapshot.vertical | snapshot.display_name | snapshot.brand.name|bot_name|tagline|support_email|support_phone. tenant_id NOT in body.
error_codes: 400 no tenant on admin | 401 | 403 not company admin | 409 already published | 422 phone/profile validation | 404 tenant missing
frontend_bind_notes: Call on Finish setup only. Prefill wizard from /api/auth/me (tenant_id). After 200: refreshIdentity() then navigate to /tenants/{tenant_id}/overview. Do not pass tenant_id in JSON. Helper: adminsApi.firstLoginComplete({waba_phone_id, mobile_number, snapshot})
curl: curl --location 'http://localhost:9000/api/auth/first-login/complete' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --header 'username: japan' --header 'session_id: b4lLGk7cQ4hFZMHM5AwG7ig7vcV_Y3WnZ6tA-ZX5kFk' --data-raw '{"waba_phone_id":"+919876543210","mobile_number":"+919876543210","snapshot":{"vertical":"generic","display_name":"Japan Co","brand":{"name":"Japan Co","bot_name":"Asha","tagline":"Here to help","support_email":"support@example.com","support_phone":"+919876543210"}}}'
